case.title: Interview captured at exactly 21:00:00 local is off-hours

submissions.open_text: Tap runs only in the evening so we fill jerricans before dinner.
Queue at the kiosk takes almost an hour every morning.

case.why: The evening threshold is inclusive ('at or after 21:00'). 21:00:00+03:00 is exactly on it, so off_hours must fire. An implementation using a strict comparison (hour > 21, or time > 21:00) would stay silent. Other checks are quiet. The duration is 1500 s, which is at least 720 s. Only one other same-day submission exists, which is fewer than the 2 neighbours same_spot needs; it is also about 556 m away (0.005 deg of lat). There are 2 submissions, fewer than the 4 burst needs. Both points are inside Kondele, the texts share no content words, and there is no voice note.
